name: Browser
description: Render a document offline in the chat container, or fetch-then-render a public URL under scoped egress.

function.name: browser
function.description: Render a document and return its title plus readable text. Offline sources (html, data: URL, owned file) always work with no internet. Online http(s) URLs require scoped egress and pass SSRF checks on the initial URL and every redirect; the fetched page is rendered offline — subresources and websockets are never retrieved live.

html.description: Raw HTML to render offline (exactly one of html/url/file).

url.description: data: URL (offline) or http(s) URL (scoped egress fetch, then offline render).

file.description: Owned workplace HTML/text file to render offline.
